name: quantum-academic-portfolio
description: Modern dark-themed academic & research portfolio for a quantum scientist / LGBTQ+ advocate — pure static site, GitHub Pages ready.

scripts.build: node build.js && mkdir -p public/styles public/js && cp src/styles/main.css public/styles/ && cp src/js/app.js public/js/
